Marching snare samples — MuseScore Drumline (MDL)

The recorded marching snare in marching-snare.js is the solo snare from
MuseScore Drumline: hit_1-4, crush_short_1-4 and crush_long_1-4 from
https://github.com/musescore/mdl (resources/sound/MDL_samples/snare).
Rudiment Room trims their silent tails, applies MDL's own level balance and
stores them as 16-bit PCM (tools/pack-marching-snare.py in the app's
repository); the sound is otherwise as MDL recorded it.

MDL's license, quoted from license.txt in that repository:

  MuseScore Drumline
  License: Creative Commons 0 (CC0)

  Sample programming by S. Christian Collins
  Samples used include:
   . Original samples recorded by Amir Oosman and S. Christian Collins.
   . NSA Drumkit by Dean
   . VCSL
   . VSCO2

  To the extent possible under law, the person who associated CC0 with
  MuseScore Drumline has waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights
  to MuseScore Drumline.

  You should have received a copy of the CC0 legalcode along with this
  work.  If not, see <http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>.

CC0 asks for no credit. It is given anyway: thank you to S. Christian Collins,
Amir Oosman and the MuseScore project.
